items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: I had on that job, I played the piano for that job. I had Albin Nicholas.

ctx.x: Towards the river, up the lake.

It's a vacant lot there now. Well, I had on that job, I played the piano for that job. I had Albin Nicholas. I'm crying there. And I had a banjo player, they called Joe Robinson. He sang and played a banjo. Very fine songs. He was Nookie Johnson's brother. And on drums, I had Arnold Dupes. And I left the job. And I left the job. Yeah, on trumpet, I want to say it too. Had Anorma Twier. And I left the job. Yeah, on trumpet, I want to say it too. Had Anorma Twier. That was a Cadillac job. He was with you later at…
That was a cabaret. That was a cabaret. That was a cabaret. Well, I went out. I was out to field then.
